content.text: The document contains only a Vendor-granted MFN in our favour, and expressly disclaims any MFN commitment by us.

input.quote: 7.6 Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms.
input.rationale: The only MFN-type provision runs in our favour: clause 7.6 obliges Vendor to charge Customer fees no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers. There is no obligation on Customer to extend Vendor best terms, match third-party offers, or disclose competitor pricing; clause 12.3 reinforces this by confirming Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment. Searches for MFN, "favourable/favorable", benchmarking and exclusivity language across Sections 7, 12 and 30 found no customer-side MFN. Per the rule's detection guidance, a Vendor-granted MFN is compliant and no redline is proposed.
